definitions.explanation: Putting off an event to a later time.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}が{延期|えんき}になった。
{会議|かいぎ}を{来週|らいしゅう}に{延期|えんき}する。
examples.english: To postpone the meeting to next week.

notes:
{延期|えんき} means postponement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {延期|えんき}する (to postpone)
- {延期|えんき}になる (to be postponed)
- 〜に{延期|えんき}する (postpone to ~)
- {雨天|うてん}{延期|えんき} (rain delay)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {延期|えんき}: postponement (rescheduled to later)
- {中止|ちゅうし}: cancellation (not happening)
- {延長|えんちょう}: extension (making longer)
